title: Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Claim Settlement Terms by Tier
content:
The settlement-side terms of Homeowner Service Contracts that vary by tier are listed here, one row per term.

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unknown, undetectable pre-existing conditions covered | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Improper prior installation or repair covered | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Repair-to-replace threshold (repair estimate as a fraction of contracted replacement cost) | 0.60 | 0.60 | 0.60 | 0.60 | 0.60 | 0.60 |
| Parts lead time beyond which Bridgewell replaces (days) | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Out-of-network reimbursement cap per request (USD) | 250.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 300.00 | 400.00 | 500.00 |
| Cash-in-lieu offer validity (days after the offer is issued) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Cash-in-lieu payment window (days after acceptance) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Terms defined

- **Unknown pre-existing conditions** — whether failures from conditions that existed before coverage but were unknown and not detectable by visual inspection are covered.
- **Improper installation** — whether failures caused by improper prior installation or repair are covered.
- **Repair-to-replace threshold** — the repair estimate as a fraction of contracted replacement cost at or above which Bridgewell replaces instead of repairing; 0.60 is sixty percent.
- **Parts lead time** — the calendar days of parts lead time beyond which Bridgewell replaces instead of waiting for parts.
- **Out-of-network reimbursement cap** — the maximum reimbursement per request for a pre-authorized licensed contractor of the customer's choosing.
- **Cash-in-lieu offer validity** — the calendar days after a cash-in-lieu offer is issued during which the customer may accept it.
- **Cash-in-lieu payment window** — the calendar days after acceptance within which the cash-in-lieu payment must be issued.

## Tier comparison notes

Only Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum covers improper prior installation or repair; Bridgewell HomeCare Gold and Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum cover unknown, undetectable pre-existing conditions. The threshold, the parts lead time and both cash-in-lieu day counts are the same on all six tiers; the out-of-network cap rises from 250.00 to 500.00 across the tiers.
